propositions: rebar must support an S3 bucket with SSE-KMS encryption as the ticket-store remote via git-remote-s3 helper while preserving git/event data format and auto-commit/auto-push flow

concurrent or legacy pushes can create multiple <sha>.bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at multiple SHAs and fresh clones to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed'
when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below the minimum version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install
the multiple-bundles state must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent heads under a repo-level repair lock into a single bundle, preserving all commits/events from every head

rebar operators must be able to enable and configure the S3 backend from documentation alone, including optional dependency declaration, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket setup, and sync.remote configuration
